reviewedNotAdopted.finding: T3 Code main at this pin has no Ollama, LM Studio, or llama.cpp provider. OpenAI-compatible local endpoints appear only as configuration inside OpenCode or Pi, not as a scanner.

T3 Code does not ship first-class OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or xAI HTTP adapters. Cloud model access is the signed-in CLI (ChatGPT plan, Claude, Grok, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, Antigravity, ACP). apps/server/src/cloud is the T3 Connect relay, not an LLM provider.

The ACP Registry driver downloads third-party agents into a T3-owned tools directory. At cfafb4bb, Windows on ARM falls back to a windows-x86_64 archive when the agent publishes no windows-aarch64 binary (76cb251d). Local AI Kit does not download executables from a remote manifest. User-configured local ACP commands stay on the existing explicit native-profile path.

T3 Code keeps many ChatGPT registrations and a primary-to-remote handoff. Local AI Kit keeps one managed registration per state directory and still rejects an identity change. Remote refresh-token transfer was not ported.
T3 Code can link a shared CODEX_HOME into a shadow home so two accounts continue the same threads. That layout is a T3 session feature, not passive discovery.

T3 Code's current Cursor driver uses the bundled Cursor SDK and hides the CLI path. At cfafb4bb, Auto threads use Cursor's Auto-review (2d943723). Local AI Kit still only inventories cursor-agent and does not execute Cursor.

CodexInstallation.ts downloads a pinned Codex release archive into a T3-owned tools directory. At cfafb4bb, Windows extraction uses the system tar and retries a rename while Defender holds the new binary (364f5084). Local AI Kit inventories a Codex binary that is already installed and does not download executables.
Gemini CLI is not a built-in T3 driver. The ACP Registry can install @google/gemini-cli. Local AI Kit already inventories gemini from PATH and GEMINI_CLI_HOME and does not download it.

ClaudeExecutable.ts follows a Windows npm .cmd/.bat/.ps1 launcher to @anthropic-ai/claude-code bin/claude.exe or cli.js so the Claude Agent SDK can spawn it. Local AI Kit inventories the claude command and does not rewrite launcher shims.
ClaudeHome.ts notices an administrator managed-mcp.json so a session can drop --strict-mcp-config. That is execution isolation, not a discovery root.

AntigravityInstallation.ts installs a managed Antigravity build. At cfafb4bb, Windows ARM validation kills the PyInstaller tree before deleting the temp profile (895354e9). Local AI Kit inventories an already installed antigravity or agy binary and does not install one.

effect-acp drops one schema-invalid session notification instead of ending the connection (559c4b1f). Local AI Kit's ACP client already continues on an unrecognized sessionUpdate and does not fail a turn when usage_update omits used. A notification with no sessionUpdate still ends the turn.
